name: Shore
summary: Booking and business software for local service businesses (salons, barbers, wellness, coaches): 24/7 online appointments via your website, Google and Instagram, calendar and staff scheduling, client profiles, automated reminders that cut no-shows, plus email marketing and POS. Fixed monthly price with unlimited bookings — no per-booking commission.
best_for: salons, barbers, spas, wellness studios, physical therapists, craftspeople and local retailers that want bookings via Google and Instagram, no-show-reducing reminders, marketing and (optionally) POS in one fixed-price system
skip_if: you just need a simple scheduling link (a Calendly-class tool is lighter) or you run a business without appointments at all
honest_knock: It's built for local appointment businesses in the German-speaking market, and the package split shows it: booking and the till are sold as separate lines, and only All-in-One carries both. Card fees are quoted on your sales rather than published, so the package price is not the whole bill - and the POS is only sold in Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (2026-09-26, read on shore.com/en/pricing and its 'All features compared' page, in euros, excluding VAT, for businesses only) Five packages on two product lines, each with a yearly-billing and a monthly-billing rate a flat EUR 10 apart ('Yearly (Save EUR 120)'). Appointments: Booking EUR 49.90 a month billed yearly or EUR 59.90 monthly, up to 5 staff; Booking + Marketing EUR 69.90 / EUR 79.90, unlimited staff. Till: POS EUR 49.90 / EUR 59.90, up to 5 staff; POS+ EUR 69.90 / EUR 79.90, unlimited staff. Both: All-in-One EUR 119.90 / EUR 129.90, unlimited staff. An 'Oktoberfest Sale' ('up to 40%', for a limited time, no end date given) cuts the first 12 months to EUR 29.90 / 39.90 (Booking and POS), EUR 49.90 / 59.90 (Booking + Marketing and POS+) and EUR 89.90 / 99.90 (All-in-One); list price applies from month 13. Card-reader fees are no longer published: they are 'based on your sales' and quoted on request. Cloud TSE EUR 9/month, professional website EUR 65/month, branded web app EUR 40/month; more than 10 locations goes to Key Account. Hardware: Shore Complete bundle EUR 1,499, card reader EUR 69, dock EUR 49, stand EUR 199, cash drawer EUR 99, Epson receipt printer EUR 269. The POS is only sold in Germany, Austria and Switzerland. 14-day free trial. Yearly payment carries a 12-month initial term; monthly billing cancels with 14 days' notice to the end of the period.
